# NumberEditLib:text

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.10</span></div>

Set the NumberEdit text handler.

```lua
field:text(handler)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handler` | function | yes | the function which will return the display string based on the value |

## Returns

Nothing.
